patch.evidence: The author number 58 and display number 23 are clear. The first raised replacement has an upright and a rightward foot, favouring barred L, but a pale rising diagonal cannot be allocated securely between the surviving letter and the heavily cancelled lower letter; retain barred L/barred K uncertainty. The second exponent sign has a closed counter and long descender, favouring the existing g/G reading over alpha. The U is the repeated model index. A diagonal quotient slash precedes the four-line denominator; it is not an opening parenthesis. The full groupe ending is present after ss-. The apparent upper cap of the generator is crossed by the engendré descender, so L/I remains doubtful. The final I has top and bottom serifs; its top serif is not a separate overbar. Prime/subscript ordering is only an encoding difference.
